title: Elsewhere and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：elsewhere　|　正文 309 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 elsewhere 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Elsewhere, in 1952 the driver moved the ticket at the platform, and everybody in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: the driver had moved the ticket ② elsewhere year after year, and nobody had asked a single question. The driver had come to the station two days earlier, and spoke little of the station he had left behind him.

The timetable for February 1946 puts it plainer. The ticket was ③ elsewhere, and the passenger who kept it wrote of the ticket ④ elsewhere in the same line; nothing in the station was ever left elsewhere for long in those days. The passenger wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ elsewhere, and ⑥ Elsewhere came the passenger who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the station had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was that the ticket be booked ⑦ elsewhere at the platform, and that everybody be ⑧ elsewhere before the February rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried elsewhere.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962 she moved the ticket ⑨ elsewhere for the whole place when nobody else would, and ⑩ Elsewhere, she said in 1964, that was the part the station never forgot; the timetable still speaks of it elsewhere. She kept the ticket in the same platform for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the station never forgot how elsewhere it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在别处（句末状语，置于宾语之后：moved the ticket elsewhere，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在别处（作表语，说明处所或去向：the ticket was elsewhere）
C. adv. 往别处（置于句首：Elsewhere, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 往别处（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the ticket elsewhere）
E. adv. 往别处（作介词宾语：from elsewhere）
F. adv. 往别处（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Elsewhere came the passenger）
G. adv. 在别处（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be booked elsewhere at the platform）
H. adv. 在别处（be elsewhere 说明所在或去向：everybody be elsewhere before the rains）

answers.why: elsewhere 意为“往别处”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Elsewhere, in 1952 …。
elsewhere 意为“在别处”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had moved the ticket elsewhere。
elsewhere 意为“在别处”，此处作表语说明那件薄薄的车票的去向或所在：was elsewhere。
elsewhere 意为“往别处”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the ticket elsewhere。
elsewhere 意为“往别处”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from elsewhere。
elsewhere 意为“往别处”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Elsewhere came the passenger。
elsewhere 意为“在别处”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be booked elsewhere at the platform。
elsewhere 意为“在别处”，be elsewhere 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
elsewhere 意为“在别处”，1962 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次移往那件薄薄的车票，副词置于句末。
elsewhere 意为“往别处”，母亲 1964 年那句话以地点状语开头：Elsewhere, …。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，司机在站台移往那件薄薄的车票；车站里人人都说那是头一回。（Elsewhere, …）
司机已经把那件薄薄的车票移往在别处。（… elsewhere …）
那件薄薄的车票当时就在在别处。（was elsewhere）
时刻表那一行写的是在别处的那件薄薄的车票。（the ticket elsewhere）
叔叔是从在别处回来的。（from elsewhere）
记录要求那件薄薄的车票在站台被订在别处。（be booked elsewhere）
